levels.surface: أبو العباس أحمد بن يحيى بن زكريا القطان
بكر بن عبد الله بن حبيب

notes: The bracketed opening «[أبي ... رفعه إلى أبي عبد الله ... و]» is an editor's insertion of a route: read as a link (its chain is written), its gap «رفعه إلى» is an unnamed link
The second isnad («حدثنا أحمد بن الحسن ...») ends at Ibn Abbas, who relays the Prophet's words (rule 5: «قلت لعبد الله بن العباس»; the asked answers, rule 6)
needs_ruling: two sayings in one report (the Imam's, then Ibn Abbas's) and the second isnad's status after «و» (rule 11)
